text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led along by Copano Rickey, we arrived at 
a general goods shop in the shopping mall.
choice_data_list: So, what did you want to buy again?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, it's a little organizer for 
fan letters♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've been getting letters from so many 
people lately, and the box in my room is 
about to overflow.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
According to feng shui, it's said you 
should dispose of letters after a certain 
period of time. But, there are exceptions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
They say that letters from someone you 
like or letters with good news will be 
fine as long as you keep them in a sunny 
place.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to treasure the letters I received 
from all my fans♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I don't really get feng shui, but seeing 
you run gave me so much energy!" and 
things like that—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Things like, 'Thanks to you, Rickey, I 
started practicing Feng Shui too!' or—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because everyone's voices always give me 
strength!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ The color, shape, and 
breathability are all perfect! Once I'm 
back in my room, I'm putting my letters in 
this basket!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I picked a pretty spacious basket, but 
once this one gets full, I'll have to buy 
an even bigger one—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But what if I get so many fan letters 
that they fill up my whole room?!
choice_data_list:
If it's Ricky, she'll probably make it 
happen in the not-so-distant future.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa! I wonder if Papa knows a good 
way!? Maybe I should ask him next time?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... we'll have to think of a way, 
but if we could get that much support, 
that'd make me super happy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Picturing a bright future seemed to fire 
up Copano Rickey's motivation even more.
